 The numbers behind Governor Hochul’s very good Election Day
 By David Lombardo | 2026-11-11T13:51:54-05:00 November 11th, 2026 | 
 Gov. Kathy Hochul will end up with more than 3.6 million votes in her re-election victory, but where did the support come from?
 We try to explain the shift in the governor’s favor from 2022 with the help of political analyst Michael Lange , who talks about Hochul’s alliance with NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani, the national blue wave, and the lackluster GOP gubernatorial campaign.
 We also try to figure out whether the top of the ticket in New York came with any coattails this year and Michael discusses the writing process for his book.
 And if you enjoy Dispatches from Planet Albany , please leave a rating and consider becoming a  recurring contributor  to support the podcast (because we could really use the money).
